delta_review.summary: The remediation adds payment-scoped idempotency keys and a new provider outcome used to report a replay.
delta_review.evidence: All four delta files and the complete base-to-head retry path were inspected.

finding_revalidation.evidence: The current implementation derives one key from the immutable payment ID, and the lost-response regression proves all attempts reuse it.

forward_risk_review.surface: New provider idempotency replay outcome and its public routing contract
forward_risk_review.reason: The fix emits a new public outcome while changing retry consumers and tests.
checks: Run the lost-response regression with a real provider-client observation
Assert every emitted provider outcome belongs to PROVIDER_OUTCOMES

independent_pass.summary: The independent delta pass confirmed PRR-001 closure and reproduced the missing public outcome registration.

decision.rationale: PRR-001 is resolved, but the remediation emits idempotency_replay without declaring it in the stable PROVIDER_OUTCOMES registry.

summary: This re-review closes the duplicate-charge finding with a payment-scoped idempotency key. The independent forward-risk track found that the remediation also emits a new public provider outcome that is absent from the advertised registry. Approval renewal is withheld until PRR-002 is resolved.

change_map.change: All attempts for one payment reuse a key derived from its immutable payment ID.
change_map.external_behavior: An accepted request followed by a lost response no longer creates a second charge.
change_map.validation: Lost-response regression passes at the current head.

change_map.change: The client emits idempotency_replay when the provider returns the original operation.
change_map.external_behavior: Registry-based consumers receive an undeclared public value.

findings.title: New idempotency replay outcome is absent from the public registry
findings.observation: provider-client.ts emits idempotency_replay, but PROVIDER_OUTCOMES does not include that value.
findings.trigger: A lost-response retry returns the provider's original operation and a caller routes the outcome through the stable registry.
findings.impact: A documented registry consumer treats a legitimate package outcome as unknown and can select the wrong recovery path.

evidence.description: A real provider-client observation returned idempotency_replay and the registry membership assertion failed.

findings.remediation: Declare idempotency_replay in PROVIDER_OUTCOMES and validate real emitted observations against the registry.
findings.verification: The replay observation belongs to PROVIDER_OUTCOMES and the package and retry tests pass.

findings.title: Lost-response retries can submit the same payment twice
findings.observation: The current implementation reuses a payment-scoped idempotency key across every retry attempt.
findings.trigger: The provider accepts the first charge and the response is lost.
findings.impact: The provider returns the original operation instead of creating a duplicate charge.

evidence.description: The lost-response regression records one logical provider key across all attempts.

findings.verification: The original trigger now returns one provider operation and uses one payment-scoped key.

required_actions.action: Register the new provider outcome and add executable contract coverage.
Make provider retries idempotent and add a lost-response regression test.

risks.description: The original duplicate-charge path is covered by a current-head regression.
Registry-based consumers cannot classify the new replay outcome.

assumptions.statement: One immutable payment ID represents one logical provider charge.
assumptions.method: Inspect the payment identity contract and run the lost-response regression.
assumptions.evidence: Payment IDs are immutable and every retry in the regression reuses the derived key.
assumptions.impact_if_false: The idempotency fix could merge distinct logical payments or fail to deduplicate retries.

assumptions.statement: Provider sandbox replay behavior matches production.
assumptions.impact_if_false: A later live validation may require rollout-specific mitigation.

non_blocking_recommendations.recommendation: Emit a metric for idempotency replays.
non_blocking_recommendations.value: This makes rollout anomalies and duplicate prevention visible.
